WITH MediaTypeRates AS (
  SELECT
    mt.Name AS MediaTypeName,
    SUM(t.Bytes) * 1.0 / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS ByteRate,
    COUNT(*) AS TrackCount
  FROM MediaType mt
  JOIN Track t ON t.MediaTypeId = mt.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY mt.Name
),
OverallAverage AS (
  SELECT AVG(ByteRate) AS AverageRate
  FROM MediaTypeRates
)
SELECT
  AVG(mtr.ByteRate) AS AverageRate,
  AVG(mtr.TrackCount) AS AverageTrackCount,
  AVG(mtr.ByteRate - oa.AverageRate) AS AverageExcessRate
FROM MediaTypeRates mtr
CROSS JOIN OverallAverage oa
WHERE mtr.ByteRate > oa.AverageRate;
